claims.text: A dispatch chain in a module nothing can run is not a way in, and admitting it would invent entry points that no human or tool can actually take.
claims.why: The code only iterates over entry_mods (modules already in entries) for dispatch and loop detection, confirming the claim.

claims.text: HTTP handlers never import inside the branch; they call ``core.envelope`` or ``hierarchy.capabilities`` against a module-level import. Resolving the referenced name back through the import that bound it is the only way those routes reach anything.
claims.why: The chunk does not contain the HTTP handling code or the definition of _module_level_bindings, so the claim about HTTP handlers cannot be verified against this chunk alone.

observations.what: The function _named_module_targets calls _module_level_bindings, which is not defined in this chunk.
The variable entry_mods is computed from entries, but entries is being built up in the same loop; this could lead to missing dispatch chains from modules added later in the loop.
